text:
jordan: Quick FYI — I bumped the canary routing for m-llama2-13b-fast to 10% to soak some real traffic. Doing this because we saw the 95th latency drop in test envs.
anjali: @jordan did this go through the usual change approval? we need an audit trail for compliance.
jordan: short version: yes, verbal ok with @liam earlier, but I didn't file the formal change ticket. my bad. I made the change via the console since we were saturating the old variant.
liam: that's fine for the canary, but compliance wants who clicked, what exact route weights changed, and the pre/post config snapshot. export needs to be tamper-evident.
maya: +1 on the pre/post. Also can we include the rollout reason text? Compliance likes human-readable justification attached to the event.
jordan: agree. what's the minimal export schema we can produce quickly? CSV? NDJSON? eventstream?
liam: NDJSON would be easiest to preserve structured diffs. example lines:

```
{"event":"route_change","actor":"jordan","ts":1719998888,"resource":"routing_policy:canary-m-llama2-13b-fast","before":{"weight":0.02},"after":{"weight":0.10},"reason":"latency-soak-2026-03-20"}
{"event":"approval","actor":"liam","ts":1719998895,"note":"verbal ok via slack"}
```

anjali: We should redact token IDs and cluster IPs. Also separate actor identity resolution from raw principal (i.e., map iam_principal -> display_name in export metadata).
ops-bot: policy-change recorded: id=pc_9f3a, actor=jordan, method=console, ts=1719998888. Audit record available at /internal/audit/pc_9f3a
maya: ops-bot link is helpful. Can the export include both the raw change and a human-friendly timeline? e.g., step 1: propose, step 2: approve, step 3: apply, step 4: verify
liam: yes — timeline entries can be separate NDJSON events with a field "phase". That keeps machine-parsable and easy to rehydrate for UI.
jordan: compliance asked for signed events (HMAC) so exports can't be tampered with after generation. Is that doable short-term?
liam: doable: sign the NDJSON blob server-side with a per-tenant export key in KMS. we need to add signature metadata: export_id, signature, key_version.
anjali: also retention: legal wants 7 years for routing policy decisions; infra wants to sample older records to reduce storage. can we support tiered retention in the export manifest?
maya: export manifest idea: includes retention policy, actors, PII-redaction-level, signature, and indices of included events.
jordan: what's the gettable endpoint? I want to be able to fetch the raw NDJSON via the console and download it.
liam: proposal: /api/v1/audit/exports/{export_id}. GET returns a signed manifest + preigned S3 URL for the blob. UI will show timeline preview (first N events) non-redacted if viewer has permission.
anjani: crucial: permission gating — only users with audit:read role can download unredacted blobs. Others get redacted view.
ops-bot: export job queued: export_job=ej_4422, scope=pc_9f3a, requester=anjali, redaction=pii_token_ips, retention=7y, format=ndjson
jordan: thanks. can we also include the console diff snapshot as a small delta for quick human review? like a JSON patch attached to the manifest.
liam: yes, attach a JSON Patch (RFC 6902) in the manifest as "diff_patch" field. If large, store in blob and reference byte ranges.
maya: follow-up UX asks: show a "who changed what" flyout in the routing policy page with the last 5 changes and a link to full export. also allow admins to trigger immediate export for a policy range.
anjani: and add a checkbox on the apply dialog: "Create audit export and require approval" as an opt-in for sensitive policies.
jordan: for the immediate next step: liam, can you prototype an NDJSON manifest + signed export flow? anjali, you'll own the permission matrix and retention policy writeup? maya, can you mock the flyout?
liam: yes. I'll sketch an API and a small lambda to sign via KMS. ETA EOD Friday for a rough alpha.
anjali: I'll draft the permission/rbac doc and retention table by Tuesday.
maya: mockups by Wednesday morning. I'll add an example flyout showing timeline + pre/post JSON patch.
ops-bot: reminder: scheduled audit export job executor runs every 2m. current queue depth=3.
compliance-bot: escalate? legal requires manual approval for exports older than 5 years. Please file a ticket if you plan retention beyond that.
jordan: noted. I'll file the retrospective ticket for the informal approval and link this thread.
liam: one last thing — can we include route evaluation hashes so we can replay routing decisions deterministically in test infra? add a field eval_hash computed from rule set + seed.
anjani: good call. include eval_hash.
maya: ok let's sync Wed 9am to review the prototype and the export manifest shape. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
